name: duopore-public-property-photo-captions
description: Turn your room notes into clear captions for property photos.

interface.longDescription: Turn your room notes into clear captions for property photos. Enter the room label and the details you observed, then review the captions. Use the result to keep the listing's photo text clear and factual. The app works from your notes; it does not view photos, identify rooms or invent property features.
defaultPrompt: Write property photo captions using only these room notes.
Keep these room captions factual and ready for review.

positive.prompt: Use Property Caption Worksheet with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"photos":[{"id":"PH1","order":1,"roomLabel":"Kitchen","observedDescription":"Window beside the sink.","reviewed":true}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"1 supplied-observation captions; 0 need review.","rows":[{"id":"PH1","order":1,"caption":"Kitchen: Window beside the sink.","status":"reviewed"}],"warnings":["Captions use your observations verbatim.
